name: American Clean Resources Group, Inc.
summary: American Clean Resources Group, Inc. (ACRG) is an early-stage enterprise that plans to offer specialized processing and authorized toll milling services. Its primary objective involves the recovery of valuable and critical minerals, such as gold, silver, and the platinum group elements, from excavated ore. The company, which adopted its current name in June 2022, was formerly known as Standard Metals Processing, Inc. Established in 1985, this Gadsden, Alabama-based entity operates as a subsidiary of Granite Peak Resources, LLC.
